summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Surveys Module (Encuestas Institucionales). Backend: 33/33 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features verified - Survey CRUD, status filters, Results modal with Recharts (bar/pie charts), View modal, participation indicators.
passed_tests: POST /api/surveys - Creates survey with specific target roles
PUT /api/surveys/{id} - Changes status from draft to active
PUT /api/surveys/{id}/close - Returns error for already closed survey
POST /api/surveys/{id}/answer - Submits answer to active survey
GET /api/surveys/{id}/results - Returns correct counts after answers

context_for_next_testing_agent: Surveys module fully functional. Route is /school/:subdomain/encuestas. Admin roles (owner/admin/director) can create/edit/delete surveys and view results. Non-admin users can only see active surveys targeting their role and can answer once per survey. Results modal uses Recharts for bar and pie charts. Status filters: draft, active, closed. Target roles: teacher, student, parent, admin, director (empty = all users).

backend_endpoints.GET /api/surveys: List surveys with status filter, includes response_count, user_has_responded, participation_rate
backend_endpoints.GET /api/surveys/{id}: Get single survey with response stats
backend_endpoints.POST /api/surveys: Create survey with question, options, target_roles, status (draft/active)
backend_endpoints.PUT /api/surveys/{id}: Update survey (cannot edit closed or change options if has responses)
backend_endpoints.POST /api/surveys/{id}/answer: Submit answer (validates active status, target role, single response)
backend_endpoints.GET /api/surveys/{id}/results: Get results with statistics and per-option counts/percentages
